content: 1. John Beard serves as the Director of the WHO Department of Ageing and Life Course (ALC) in Geneva, Switzerland. 2. Rebekah Thomas is a Technical Officer in the WHO Gender, Equity, and Human Rights Team (GER), also based in Geneva, Switzerland. 3. Joanna Vogel is a Technical Adviser in the WHO Department of Maternal, Newborn, Child, and Adolescent Health (MCA) in Geneva, Switzerland. 4. Tarun Dua is a Coordinator in the WHO Department of Evidence, Research, and Action on Mental and Brain Disorders (MER) in Geneva, Switzerland. 5. Fahmy Hanna is a Medical Officer in the WHO Department of HIV/AIDS in Geneva, Switzerland. 6. Rachael Baggeley is a Coordinator in the WHO Department of HIV/AIDS in Geneva, Switzerland. 7. Shaffiq Essajee is a Medical Officer at the WHO Regional Office for Africa, located in Brazzaville, Congo. 8. Françoise Bigirimana is a Medical Officer specializing in the prevention of mother-to-child transmission (PMTCT) at the WHO Regional Office for Africa. 9. Léopold Ouedraogo is a Reproductive Health Advisor at the WHO Regional Office for the Americas/Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) in Washington, D.C., United States. 10. Sonja Caffe is a Regional Adolescent Health Advisor at PAHO in Washington, D.C., United States. 11. Ramez Mahaini is a Regional Advisor for Reproductive Health at the WHO Regional Office for the Eastern Mediterranean in Cairo, Egypt. 12. Gunta Lazdane is a Programme Manager for Sexual and Reproductive Health in the Division of Noncommunicable Diseases and Promoting Health through the Life-Course at the WHO Regional Office for Europe in Copenhagen, Denmark. 13. Razia Pendse is an HIV Regional Advisor at the WHO Regional Office for South-East Asia in New Delhi, India. 14. Elizabeth Bukusi, Co-Chair of the Guideline Development Group (GDG), is the Chief Research Officer and Deputy Director for Research and Training at the Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI) in Nairobi, Kenya. 15. Paul Van Look, Co-Chair of the GDG, is an Independent Consultant based in Val d’Illiez, Switzerland. 16. Pascale Allotey is a Professor of Public Health and Head of Global Public Health at Monash University Malaysia, located in Bandar Sunway, Malaysia. 17. Elham Atalla is a Doctor-in-Charge at Al Hoora Health Center and a Senior Lecturer at the Royal College of Surgeons in Ireland (RCSI) – Medical University of Bahrain. She is also a Consultant Family Physician and Clinical Sexologist at Arad Health Center, Ministry of Health, Bahrain. 18. Susan Bewley is a Professor of Complex Obstetrics in the Division of Women’s Health at King’s College London and part of the Women’s Health Academic Centre at King’s Health Partners in London, United Kingdom. 19. Shalini Bharat is a researcher at the School of Health Systems Studies, Tata Institute of Social Sciences in Mumbai, India, focusing on HIV/AIDS, stigma, discrimination, and women’s health. 20. Caroline Phiri Chibwe is the Director of Mother and Child Health at the Ministry of Health in Lusaka, Zambia. 21. Sophie Dilmitis is a Consultant with the International Community of Women Living with HIV in Harare, Zimbabwe. 22. Raoul Fransen-dos Santos is a Senior Policy Adviser with the International Civil Society Support in Amsterdam, Netherlands. 23. Selma Hajri is a Consultant with the African Network for Medical Abortion (ANMA) in Tunis, Tunisia. 24. Maurice Hiza is the National Family Planning Coordinator in the Reproductive and Child Health Section of the Ministry of Health and Social Welfare in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. 25. Mona Loutfy is a clinician and researcher at the Women’s College Research Institute, Women’s College Hospital, University of Toronto, Canada, focusing on sexual and reproductive health (SRH) and stigma among women living with HIV. 26. Chisale Mhango is a Senior Lecturer in Obstetrics and Gynaecology at the College of Medicine in Blantyre, Malawi. 27. Glen Mola is a Health Systems Specialist at the School of Medicine and Health Services in Boroko, Papua New Guinea. 28. Rejoice Nkambule is the Deputy Director of Public Health Services at the Ministry of Health in Mbabane, Eswatini, with expertise in HIV prevention and treatment programs. 29. Vera Paiva is a Professor of Infectious Diseases at the University of São Paulo, Brazil, with expertise in SRH, mental health, and community interventions. 30. Quach Thi Thu Trang is a Senior Researcher and Gender-Based Violence (GBV) Program Coordinator at the Center for Creative Initiatives in Health and Population (CCIHP) in Hanoi, Vietnam. 31. Caitlin Kennedy is an Associate Professor at Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health, specializing in systematic reviews and qualitative evidence. 32. Nandi Siegfried is a Clinical Epidemiologist and Methodologist based in Cape Town, South Africa. 33. Georgina Caswell is a Regional Programme Advisor for the International HIV/AIDS Alliance in Brighton, United Kingdom. 34. Eli Coleman is the Director of the Program in Human Sexuality at the University of Minnesota, Minneapolis, USA. 35. Tyler Crone is the Co-Founder and Director of the ATHENA Network in Seattle, USA. 36. Cecilia Chung is the Co-Director of the Global Network of People Living with HIV in San Francisco, USA. 37. Faysal El-Kak is an Executive Board Member of the International Federation of Gynecology and Obstetrics (FIGO) and a faculty member at the American University of Beirut, Lebanon. 38. Asha George is the South African Research Chair in Health Systems at the University of the Western Cape, South Africa. 39. Quarraisha Abdool Karim is a Professor in Clinical Epidemiology and Associate Scientific Director at the Center for AIDS Research in South Africa (CAPRISA) in Durban, South Africa. 40. Robert Leke is the President of FIGO and a faculty member at the University of Yaoundé, Cameroon. 41. Svetlana Moroz is the Director of the Eurasian Women’s Network on AIDS in Kyiv, Ukraine. 42. Nelly Mugo is an Assistant Director in the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology at Kenyatta National Hospital and KEMRI in Nairobi, Kenya. 43. Wanjiru Mukoma is a Project Lead at LVCT Health in Nairobi, Kenya. 44. Hajjarah Nagadya is the Director of the International Community of Women Living with HIV Eastern Africa (ICWEA) in Entebbe, Uganda. 45. Caitlin Kennedy, Laura Beres, and Nandi Siegfried contributed to systematic reviews and methodological guidance for the guideline development. 46. The guideline development process included systematic reviews on topics such as safer disclosure of HIV status, integration of SRH services into HIV care, and the impact of medical and surgical abortion on women living with HIV. 47. The PICO framework was used to address priority questions related to interventions for women living with HIV, including empowerment, safe disclosure, delivery modes, and abortion outcomes.
